name: postcodes-uk
abstract: UK postcode type optimised for indexing (maintained fork), plus postal_code for any country
description: Parses and encodes UK postcodes in 32 bits optimised for indexing and partial matches. Also provides a suitable type for delivery point suffixes. This is a maintained fork of Dave Green's original postcode extension, with a fix for a heap overflow in postcode_out(), an unsafe %% index-registration fix, and compatibility patches for PostgreSQL 14 through 16+. The installed extension is still named postcode (CREATE EXTENSION postcode) -- only this PGXN distribution is named postcodes-uk, to avoid colliding with the upstream package. 2.0.0 adds postal_code, a 64-bit type covering any country's postal code (initially US and CA), additive alongside the original GB-only postcode type -- see README.md.
